_comment: Examples for catalog_reading's line, strain and size questions, keyed by the catalog's brand_slug: one store listing per catalog entry, the entry named by a selector (category, subtype, line, strain, size, as in catalog_fix) that must name one active entry. A question shows a couple of them (catalog_reading.EXAMPLES_SHOWN), from entries like the product being read whose answer is one of its options, the listings sharing most words with the one being read first. size_field is the store's size field, given only where it is wrong for a product sold in one size: a wrong field shown on a product with several sizes makes every right one look doubtful (2026-10-10: a Tangerine Dream 2pk with a 5g field cost the Hash Infused 10-packs their trust). They come from review decisions (review_decisions, 2026-10-10), except Ruby Farms' Grand Daddy Purple Rose Blunt, read as that Rose Petal entry before there were examples.
